proof_obligations.tree: N-1 adjacent directed edges, root indegree 0, all others indegree 1, all nodes reachable
proof_obligations.schedule: directed link <=1; up/down ramp <=2; every receiver ejects (N-1)*m flits
proof_obligations.formal_bound: relaxes network coupling, therefore every component is necessary but not sufficient
proof_obligations.area: analytic only; calendar and multicast incremental terms carry +/-30% sensitivity
